(2) QUANTITY VARIATION: SAIL/BSL reserves the right to enhance/reduce the orde red quantity by 25%. (3)Packing: The packing shall be strong enough to ensure safe perseverance up to the final points of destination. Each of the bearing must be securely packed in a single package to ensure that it is received at BSL's premises without any damage during transportation and h andling. The bearing(s) must be cushioned adequately within the package to prevent mo vement during transportation. The vendor must ensure that the bearing is covered with moisture-resistant and corrosion-preventive layers to protect against rust or environmental damage du ring transit. Edge protectors should be added to shield the corners and edges of the bearing from potential damage. 4)Identification: A clear manufacturer's identification mark must be placed on the non-working s urface of the bearing(s). This mark should include: i)Manufacturer’s name ii)Part number or unique identification number iii)Batch or lot number Ensure that the identification marking is durable, non-removable, and does not affect the performance and fitment. The identification mark must be distinct and easily visible so that the same can be differentiated from other Bearing upon arrival.

5)Sealing and Labeling: The packaging must be securely sealed to prevent accidental opening or tampe ring. Ensure that the package is labeled with handling instructions, e.g.:- i)"Fragile – Handle with Care" ii)"Keep Dry" iii)Weight. iv)PO No. and Date v)Manufacturer's Name vi)Item text and material code (6) Supplies to BSL shall be guaranteed by the manufacturer with respect to ori ginality, dimensional accuracy and quality. Firms are requested to give the equivalent bearings number against the item in their offer and also to confirm specifically that bearing offered by them is exact equivalent to the requisitioned bearing. (7) Standard Guarantee clause for procurement of the bearings is: 12 M onths from date of installation / 18 months from date of supply, whichever is ear lier. *********************************************************************** C. S. CITY 5) INSPECTION : Inspection details: Inspection Plan No : 13 Inspection Plan Version : 00001
